title: Conditional resident honesty root
objective: Bind the existing unequal-bound honesty scheduler into a live KCZ2-gated resident root while preserving equal-bound skip and explicit unsupported frontiers

oracles: Authenticated PARI 2.17.4 unequal-bound scheduler and collector transcript

handoff.summary: Added a conditional resident honesty root selected from live KCZ/KCZ2 counters. Equal counts retain the zero-work H1 skip; the predeclared unequal cubic enters the existing transactional scheduler, publishes every ideal/norm to a collector callback, commits 50 exact RNG/retry transitions, and returns restart-required after 51 failures. Success and automorphism paths expose explicit unsupported frontiers without consuming an extra RNG draw.
risks: The composed unequal implementation remains intentionally restricted to the authenticated C1=5, C2=31 cubic layout.
Successful checked primes, nontrivial automorphism orbits, outer primitive-part, and high-bit ideal reduction remain explicit frontiers.
next_steps: Bind the resident driver's no-cache collector closure directly to the root callback and route restart-required to START.
Add a separate successful unequal-bound fixture before implementing KCZ increment/restoration generically.
